svg.title: RAG Pipeline Flowchart
svg.desc: A flowchart showing the full RAG pipeline from PDF document input through chunking, embedding, vector storage, query processing, retrieval, reranking, LLM inference, optional translation, to final response.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Tell me more about PDF processing in RAG pipelines')

sendPrompt('What embedding models are used in RAG?')
sendPrompt('How does Chroma vector database store embeddings?')
sendPrompt('How is the user question used in a RAG pipeline?')
sendPrompt('What is query rewriting in RAG?')
sendPrompt('How is context selected from ranked results?')
sendPrompt('Tell me about Llama 3.2 and Ollama for local inference')
sendPrompt('When is translation used in RAG pipelines?')
sendPrompt('What does the final response look like in a RAG system?')
